prompt_text: Best donor CRM with online giving built in
response_text:
The best donor CRMs with **online giving built in** for most small–mid sized nonprofits today are **Givebutter**, **Donorbox**, and **Bloomerang**, with **DonorPerfect** and **Virtuous** as stronger (but pricier/more complex) options for larger or more advanced teams.[1][2][3][5][7][8][9]

Below is a concise comparison to help you pick based on budget, size, and needs.

---

### 1. Top picks at a glance

| CRM | Best for | Online giving features | Pricing notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Givebutter** | Small–mid nonprofits wanting an all‑in‑one free stack | Donation pages, events, ticketing, peer‑to‑peer, embeddable forms, text-to-give; all tied directly to donor profiles[2][8] | Core fundraising + CRM tools are **free**; platform/processing fees on transactions[2] |
| **Donorbox** | Small–mid orgs that prioritize **donations first**, CRM second | Robust donation pages, recurring giving, text-to-give, kiosks, crowdfunding; flows directly into donor records[1][7] | Free tier + monthly plans; payment and platform fees on donations[7] |
| **Bloomerang** | Growing orgs needing deeper donor analytics & unified giving | Online donation forms, event registration, email, stewardship tools; unified giving platform with built‑in fundraising tools[6][9] | Paid; priced for small–mid orgs and scales up |
| **DonorPerfect** | Established orgs with complex data and reporting needs | Integrated online forms for donations and event registration that flow directly into donor records[3] | Paid; more traditional mid‑market pricing |
| **Virtuous** | Mid–large nonprofits / sophisticated fundraising teams | CRM + online giving + automation and marketing in one connected platform[5] | Premium pricing, designed for scaling organizations[5] |

---

### 2. Brief tool overviews

#### Givebutter (all‑in‑one, free core CRM)
- **What it is:** Modern nonprofit platform that bundles **CRM, fundraising, and marketing** tools.[2][8]  
- **Online giving:**  
  - Donation pages, embeddable forms, peer‑to‑peer, events, ticketing, text‑to‑give, and digital wallets.[2][8]  
  - All gifts and interactions automatically populate donor profiles in its CRM.[2][8]  
- **Why choose it:**  
  - Core CRM + fundraising tools are **completely free** for any contact list size; you pay via processing/platform fees on transactions.[2]  
  - Very strong option if you want a **single system** for donor data, campaigns, and giving, with minimal upfront cost.

#### Donorbox (donations‑first with solid CRM)
- **What it is:** A **donation and donor management** platform with a nonprofit CRM built in.[1][7]  
- **Online giving:**  
  - Optimized donation forms, recurring gifts, text‑to‑give, kiosk giving, crowdfunding, and membership options.[7]  
  - Data flows into Donorbox CRM where you can view donor history and manage supporters.[1][7]  
- **Why choose it:**  
  - Very easy to add online giving to an existing website.  
  - Good if **online giving performance** is your top priority and you want a straightforward CRM attached.

#### Bloomerang (relationship‑focused CRM with giving built in)
- **What it is:** A well‑known **nonprofit CRM** focused on donor retention and relationships.[6][9]  
- **Online giving:**  
  - Online donation forms and other giving tools as part of its **unified giving platform**.[9]  
- **Why choose it:**  
  - Strong donor analytics and stewardship tools; good fit if you’re scaling beyond basic CRMs and want one vendor for giving + CRM.

#### DonorPerfect (mature fundraising CRM with integrated forms)
- **What it is:** Long‑standing **fundraising and donor management** system used by many nonprofits.[3]  
- **Online giving:**  
  - **Integrated online forms** that push gift information directly into donor records for immediate acknowledgment and reporting.[3]  
- **Why choose it:**  
  - Suitable for organizations that need **robust reporting, grants & gift tracking, and mass mailings** along with integrated online giving.[3]

#### Virtuous (advanced CRM + giving + automation)
- **What it is:** **Virtuous CRM+** is a modern, connected fundraising platform combining donor management, marketing automation, and fundraising tools.[5]  
- **Online giving:**  
  - Online forms and giving tools connected to automation and segmentation in the CRM.[5]  
- **Why choose it:**  
  - Best when you have a **larger team and complex journeys** (multi‑channel campaigns, automated workflows, sophisticated segmentation).[5]

---

### 3. How to choose based on your situation

- **If you want the best free all‑in‑one with built‑in online giving:**  
  - Start with **Givebutter**.[2][8]

- **If you’re heavily focused on donation pages and recurring giving, with simpler CRM needs:**  
  - Choose **Donorbox**.[1][7]

- **If you’re a growing nonprofit (say $500k–$5M/year) ready to invest in deeper donor CRM while keeping giving in the same system:**  
  - Evaluate **Bloomerang** and **DonorPerfect**.[3][6][9]

- **If you’re mid‑large with complex campaigns and want marketing automation tightly integrated with giving:**  
  - Look at **Virtuous**.[5]

---

If you share your approximate annual online revenue, number of contacts, and whether you need events/peer‑to‑peer or just simple donation forms, I can narrow this to 1–2 best‑fit options and outline what your stack would look like.
